title: Cover Worker result boundary, promoted queued-id and legacy output paths through production routes
outcome: Deterministic Worker regressions exercise missing resident boundaries, successful queued-prompt promotion, started follow-up failure/cancel, legacy absent-flag output, parent refusal and current-attempt persistence rather than only detached helper snapshots.
acceptance: Production result/output paths cover a started attempt whose prompt boundary is absent, a promoted queued-id completion, and a legacy absent workerOutputUnavailable field, checking exact flags, fallback and evidence scope.
Started follow-up failure/cancel, wrong-parent paged-output rejection and same-attempt contradictory child-prose persistence are covered without leaking prior commands, Notes or observations.
